note: the scene is prepared for dataset generation; no dataset is rendered here. Sweeping conditions is a research decision and hours of CPU render time.

instance_id_scheme.mechanism: Blender pass_index, read back through the Object Index render pass

available_outputs: Per-defect binary mask (threshold IndexOB to one instance)
2-D bounding box (extent of the thresholded instance mask)

capture_configs.name: CLOSE_INSPECTION
capture_configs.purpose: the range at which a hairline crack spans enough pixels

capture_configs.name: OBLIQUE_INSPECTION
capture_configs.purpose: grazing view; foreshortened, but the only geometry available for some confined surfaces

capture_configs.name: UNDERSIDE_INSPECTION
capture_configs.purpose: looking UP at a soffit, which is where a UAV has no sensor

capture_configs.name: DIFFICULT_OCCLUSION
capture_configs.purpose: the narrow reachable cone into a bearing seat or bay

capture_configs.name: LONG_RANGE_SCREENING
capture_configs.purpose: triage pass; most defects are BELOW detection here and the dataset should contain those negatives

recommended_split_note: split by SECTOR, never at random. Defects in one sector share host members, lighting and surface finish, so a random split leaks the test set into training through the background.
